_comment: Read-only monitor settings. Secrets (Helius and Alchemy keys, Telegram token) belong in .env, never here. Set a rule to null to turn it off. README.md explains every setting.
_whales: always_alert_owners = the 5 largest non-pool wallets on 2026-10-06, chosen by size only: all regular wallets that bought through the pool, none bot-like. Any outflow from them alerts. Edit freely.
_trader: Trader 1 (HWM6...yW3t), added 2026-10-06: best result on CYBERLEEK among the top 60 holders not already watched (self-funded, non-bot, 2 profitable sells, +46.5 SOL / +90% incl. its open position). Past results only, not a prediction.

traders._comment: Wallets whose trades alert you, on solana, ethereum, base, bsc or arbitrum ("chain", default solana; Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum work without a key, BNB Chain needs ANKR_API_KEY in .env). Add more with: python holder_watch.py setup, presets add CHAIN, discover, or traders add. Built-in traders ("preset": true) are renewed monthly on the server (presets renew). tokens: "any" = their trades in every token, "source" = only the token each was discovered on, "major" = only major tokens; a wallet can set its own tokens and min_trade_usd. README: Trader watch.

wallets._comment: Built-in major-token monitor for Trader 1: its buys and sells of SOL (for USDC/USDT), BTC, ETH, JUP, BONK and the other major tokens (README: Major-token monitor). Its CYBERLEEK sells still alert through always_alert_owners.
wallets.label: Trader 1

_signal_log: Every alerted trade is also written as one JSON line to signal_log (null turns it off): a stable record for backtests and a future copy-trading executor.

discovery._comment: How 'discover' ranks a token's traders by profit, on any supported chain. min_hold_minutes / max_scalp_share leave out scalpers. README: Trader discovery.
